name: SELENE sunlit arm pose

original_specification.name: SELENE sunlit arm pose
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for robotic-arm pose studies on a lunar surface.
use_cases: Robotic-arm pose studies on a lunar surface
original_specification.sources: Environment-owned sun; rig adds no source
original_specification.geometry: Actual arm snapshot and terrain remain scene-owned
original_specification.contribution_policy: Preserve single solar source and passive reflections
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural rig specification; author numeric emitters and physical cards, then calibrate in the fixed reference scene. No third-party assets included.
validation: Joint shadows and occlusion follow pose without hidden fill

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Vacuum mode: no atmospheric sky, fog, star dome or undeclared ambient light.
Solar direction and radiance are authored relative values, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry.
